novel_features.name: CAD document triage for agents
novel_features.description: Find recent CAD documents with compact structured fields that agents can carry into follow-up workspace, element, and export calls.

novel_features.name: Workspace-aware element routing
novel_features.description: Turn an Onshape document/workspace pair into a typed map of Part Studios, assemblies, BOM tabs, blobs, and application elements.

novel_features.name: Assembly instance graph capture
novel_features.description: Fetch an assembly definition and select just the instance graph fields needed for CAD review, BOM reasoning, or downstream Blender planning.

novel_features.name: Part studio inventory for export decisions
novel_features.description: List part IDs and names from a Part Studio so an agent can choose export targets without opening Onshape manually.

novel_features.name: Offline CAD archive and search
novel_features.description: Hydrate a local SQLite mirror so agents can search and analyze previously seen Onshape data without repeated live API calls.
